info.title: Layrcake API
info.description: Outcome-oriented GTM API for AI agents.

budget_credits.description: Spend ceiling for this call, in credits. If the most the call can cost is above it, the call is refused before anything is reserved or charged. It is a ceiling only: it never lets the call use a dearer source. Where spend ceilings aren't available to this key yet, a request that sets it is refused with the reason.

dry_run.description: Return this call's plan instead of running it, as of evaluated_at: the most it can cost, how many sources could answer, what budget_credits changes, and every limit the real call would trip. Nothing is looked up, reserved or charged, and a later call may differ. Where previews aren't available to this key yet, a request that sets it is refused with the reason.

want.description: What to look up. work_email and profile run the email lookup (5 credits on a hit), which returns a mobile number too when its source has one. mobile_phone also runs a separate mobile search when the email lookup found none: 17 credits when that search finds one, 5 when the mobile came with the email, nothing when no mobile is found; a mobile_phone-only request that finds only an email is free and returns nothing. Where this isn't applied for your key yet, every call runs the same email lookup whatever this lists.

budget_credits.description: Spend ceiling for this call, in credits. The same ceiling as max_credits, as a number: send one or the other. offer_token.description: Accept a previous answer's offer: send the same call again, unchanged, with its offer.offer_token. Only the premium step runs, as its own charge at the offer's price, up to its max_credits; the token works once, until expires_at, and only when max_credits is within this key's premium allowance. Where premium offers aren't available to this key yet, a request that sets it is refused with the reason.

premium.description: Consent, for this call only, to a dearer source when the standard sources come back short, as long as the whole call, the premium step included, stays within budget_credits (which it requires). The premium step is charged separately and reported in result.premium_step. Without it, budget_credits is only a ceiling. Where premium offers aren't available to this key yet, a request that sets it is refused with the reason.

audience.description: Optional goal: what you sell and to whom. Always accepted. Until goal ordering is available, signals keep today’s order with ranking.by recency and date-based why_now flags; no change to charges.

items.description: Company website domain or URL, e.g. acme.com or https://www.acme.com/about

roles.description: Hiring role filter, up to 25 job titles or phrases: a hiring post counts only when it is one of these roles. Put a role in double quotes to match it word for word. Applies to hiring only; job_change events carry no structured role field.

signals.description: Signal families to check. hiring = live job posts with evidence URLs; funding, news, job_change = dated events. Omit it to check hiring first: only hiring is checked, and a hiring company's latest funding round comes with it; list funding explicitly to check every company (a paid check). DEPRECATED: technology — a present-day vendor detection with no adoption date, not a buying signal; use find_companies.technologies instead. Still accepted in v1.

similar_to.description: Company website domain or URL, e.g. acme.com or https://www.acme.com/about

mode.description: firmographic: companies by industries (LinkedIn's names, as on find_leads), country_codes, and optionally locations and company_headcount. local: local businesses by categories (for example "dentist") in locations. Leave it out for hiring, technologies, similar_to or query. Where a mode isn't available to this key yet, a request that sets it is refused with the reason.

locations.description: Places, only with mode. firmographic: optional cities or regions inside country_codes, matched against each company's headquarters. local: required, each a city with its country, for example "Leeds, United Kingdom" or "Austin, TX".

categories.description: Only with mode local: the kinds of business, for example "dentist" or "commercial cleaning service".

keywords.description: Only with mode firmographic: 1 to 10 phrases, for example "carbon accounting" or "dental practice management". A company matches when its own description, products or specialties mention any of them; with keywords, industries may be left out. Each company then comes back with its description. Where keywords aren't available to this key yet, a request that sets them is refused with the reason.

exclude_keywords.description: Only with mode firmographic: up to 10 phrases, for example "recruitment agency" or "consultancy". Companies whose own description mentions any of them are left out. Each company then comes back with its description. Where exclude_keywords aren't available to this key yet, a request that sets them is refused with the reason.

company_headcount.description: Employee-count range. With no min or max, companies with fewer than 10 employees are left out. Any bound replaces that default: a max without a min searches from 1 employee.

route.description: Source preference for this call: balanced (the default), cheapest (the lowest-cost sources), broadest (the sources expected to find the most) or fastest. The price doesn't change with it. Where route choice isn't available to this key yet, only balanced is accepted.

leads.description: Leads mode: people from find_leads or enrich. Returns each one's best recent reason to reach out (own post, comment, reaction or company post). LinkedIn only: send no query, platforms or intent.

budget_credits.description: Leads mode, or engagers_of with read_all: a spend ceiling in credits. Leads beyond it come back not_processed; read_all reads people up to it.

engagers_of.description: Engagers mode: up to 5 post URLs (LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Facebook). Returns the people who reacted, commented, replied or reposted. Send no query, platforms, intent or audience.

per_post.description: Engagers mode: up to this many people from each source (reactions, comments, replies) of each post.

author_filter.description: Engagers mode: keep only people whose headline contains one of these words, e.g. ["head of sales", "VP sales"]. Each person read costs a small scan fee; Reddit and Facebook are skipped (no headlines).

read_all.description: Engagers mode: read everyone who engaged, not a sample, in the background (about 2 minutes per 500 people). Needs budget_credits and idempotency_key. Returns an operation: poll get_operation, which returns the people 25 at a time with next_cursor.

parameters.description: Required when confirmation_token is present; reuse it after timeout.

supersedes.description: The confirmation_token of the approval this request replaces. Needed only when that approval was already approved and hasn't started yet; one still waiting for a decision is replaced automatically. Only where Layrcake runs approved actions itself (the result's approval block says execution: server); anywhere else it is refused. A dry run doesn't check it, so it refuses it: send it on the call itself.

first_send_not_before.description: The earliest the first emails may go out (ISO 8601). They start at the first sending-window opening at least 60 minutes after a person approves, and not before this time. It can't be later than the approval's lifetime after this request (7 days by default); a later time is refused. Only where Layrcake runs approved actions itself (the result's approval block says execution: server); anywhere else it is refused. A dry run doesn't check it, so it refuses it: send it on the call itself.

202.description: Accepted, in one of two shapes. With `approval`: a person approved it, and Layrcake runs it itself (`approved` until its start, then `in_progress`); calling again with the token only reads this status. With `request_id`: the first call with this Idempotency-Key is still running; read it with get_request.

Private no-store attachment. CSV cells are quoted after prefixing an apostrophe to formula-leading text or leading tab/CR/LF; compare parsed cells after that transform, retaining ISO timestamps. Proof omits recipient identities and content; supporting settlement events remain separate from directly campaign-filtered events.

post.summary: Stop sending for the whole workspace: pauses every launching/active campaign (provider-verified) and blocks new launches, purchases and replies until an owner clears it in the console. Requires control:manage.
